semantics.label: Instructions for the learner
semantics.default: Place the words in the correct order.

semantics.label: Text
semantics.description: Ordering mode: enter one sentence per line. Every word gets its own slot, punctuation stays in place, and markers keep a multi-word phrase together as one tile, e.g. Ta elab [New Yorgis]. Gap modes (typing, dropdown, dragging): use markers to mark answers, e.g. [answer], [answer|alternative] or [!!] for an empty correct answer. The marker symbols are not displayed as part of the text.

semantics.label: Additional answer options
semantics.description: Distractor words or answers. In Drag into gaps / Whole text mode, each line here belongs to the same line/paragraph in Text; Enter separates sentences/paragraphs. Leave a line empty if that Text line must not get extra options. If you need extra options only for the second Text line, put the options on the second line here. Within one line, separate options with commas. In other answering modes, options may be separated with commas or line breaks.

semantics.label: Dropdown answer options
semantics.description: Choose how many answer options each dropdown shows.

semantics.label: How many answer options?
semantics.description: How many options each dropdown shows, drawn from the full pool of answers and distractors. The correct answer is always included.

semantics.label: Answer options position
semantics.description: Choose where the word bank / draggable answers are displayed.

semantics.label: Add image
semantics.description: Optional image shown above or to the left of the answer text. Upload a file or paste an image URL.

fields.label: Image URL
fields.description: Used only when no image is uploaded above. Paste a full https:// address.

options.label: To the left of the text

fields.label: Image width
fields.description: Leave empty to keep the image's own size. The aspect ratio is always preserved.

semantics.label: Line images
semantics.description: Add an image for a line of the Text. The first item belongs to the first line, the second to the second line, and so on. Leave an item empty (no upload and no URL) to skip that line.

fields.label: Image URL
fields.description: Used only when no image is uploaded above. Paste a full https:// address.

options.label: To the left of the text

fields.label: Image width
fields.description: Leave empty to keep the image's own size. The aspect ratio is always preserved.

fields.label: Markers
fields.description: Marker pair. In gap modes it marks the scored answers; in ordering mode it keeps a multi-word phrase together as one tile.

fields.label: Alternative answer separator
fields.description: Use this inside a marked answer in gap modes, e.g. [cat|dog].

fields.label: Shuffle answer options
fields.description: Shuffles the word bank in ordering mode and the options in dropdown and dragging modes.

fields.label: Scoring in ordering mode
fields.description: Choose whether each correctly placed word gives a point or each fully correct sentence gives a point. Gap modes always give one point per gap.

options.label: One point per word in the correct slot
One point per fully correct sentence

fields.label: Gap and slot width
fields.description: Choose whether all gaps/slots have the same width or each width follows the length of its answer. Applies to the ordering, typing and dragging modes.

options.label: Width depends on the answer length
All gaps/slots have the same width

fields.label: Show missing answers
fields.description: When checking, also show the answers the learner did not give correctly (the ones marked in orange). Turn off to hide them.

fields.label: Feedback for a completely correct answer
Empty content message
fields.default: The author has not added any text.

fields.label: Gap accessibility label
fields.description: The variable @num is replaced by the gap number.

fields.label: Word slot accessibility label
fields.description: The variable @num is replaced by the slot number.

fields.label: Sentence heading
fields.description: Shown when there is more than one sentence. The variable @num is replaced by the sentence number.
